// vga test vectors
// format: op(dec) a(hex) b(hex) c(hex)
//   0 APB read a, expect b under mask c      1 APB write b to a
//   2 AHB write b to a, size c (no waits)    3 AHB read a, size c, expect raw word b
//   4 wait a clocks
//   5 pixel at h = a[9:0], v = a[25:16] has colour b ({R,G,B}, 4 bits each)
//   6 sync a (0 hs, 1 vs): period b clocks, low for c clocks
//   7 word write b to a, then at once a read of c: expect b (bypass)
//   8 a reads of c expecting b, gaps of 0..3 clocks: one wait state when an
//     address phase meets the video fetch slot, at least one wait in all
//   9 fill the framebuffer with word b
//  10 beam at line a: STATUS.VBLANK = b, FRAME advanced by c since op 11
//  11 remember FRAME
// APB addresses are offsets: CTRL 00, STATUS 04, SCROLL 08, FRAME 0C, PALETTE 40-7C.
//
// reset values
0 00000000 00000001 FFFFFFFF
0 00000004 00000000 FFFFFFFF
0 00000008 00000000 FFFFFFFF
0 0000000C 00000000 FFFFFFFF
0 00000040 00000000 FFFFFFFF
0 00000044 0000000A FFFFFFFF
0 0000005C 00000AAA FFFFFFFF
0 00000060 00000555 FFFFFFFF
0 0000007C 00000FFF FFFFFFFF
// unmapped registers read 0
0 00000010 00000000 FFFFFFFF
0 0000003C 00000000 FFFFFFFF
// palette: 12 bits stored, the rest reads 0
1 00000044 FFFFF123 00000000
0 00000044 00000123 FFFFFFFF
1 00000044 0000000A 00000000
0 00000044 0000000A FFFFFFFF
// SCROLL: 0..239 accepted, 240 and above ignored
1 00000008 00000005 00000000
0 00000008 00000005 FFFFFFFF
1 00000008 000000F0 00000000
0 00000008 00000005 FFFFFFFF
1 00000008 FFFFFFEF 00000000
0 00000008 00000005 FFFFFFFF
1 00000008 000000EF 00000000
0 00000008 000000EF FFFFFFFF
1 00000008 00000000 00000000
0 00000008 00000000 FFFFFFFF
// CTRL: bit 0 only
1 00000000 FFFFFFFE 00000000
0 00000000 00000000 FFFFFFFF
1 00000000 00000001 00000000
0 00000000 00000001 FFFFFFFF
// framebuffer: every size
9 00000000 00000000 00000000
2 30000000 11223344 00000002
3 30000000 11223344 00000002
2 30000005 000000AB 00000000
3 30000004 0000AB00 00000002
2 30000006 0000BEEF 00000001
3 30000004 BEEFAB00 00000002
3 30000007 BEEFAB00 00000000
3 30000006 BEEFAB00 00000001
// the last word, then out of range: writes ignored, reads 0, no aliasing
2 300095FC CAFEF00D 00000002
3 300095FC CAFEF00D 00000002
2 30009600 DEADBEEF 00000002
3 30009600 00000000 00000002
3 30000000 11223344 00000002
3 3000FFFC 00000000 00000002
// a read right behind a write to the same word sees the new data
7 30000010 A5A5A5A5 30000010
7 30000010 5A5A5A5A 30000010
// reads that meet the video fetch slot wait once
8 00000064 11223344 30000000
// pixels: word 0x76543210 at row 3, word column 2 = framebuffer x 16..23,
// screen h 32..47, v 6..7
9 00000000 00000000 00000000
2 300001E8 76543210 00000002
2 300095FC F0000000 00000002
5 00050022 00000000 00000000
5 00060020 00000000 00000000
5 00060021 00000000 00000000
5 00060022 0000000A 00000000
5 00060023 0000000A 00000000
5 00060026 000000AA 00000000
5 0006002E 00000AAA 00000000
5 0006002F 00000AAA 00000000
5 00060030 00000000 00000000
5 00070028 00000A00 00000000
5 00080022 00000000 00000000
5 00640000 00000000 00000000
5 006402BC 00000000 00000000
5 01DE027D 00000000 00000000
5 01DE027E 00000FFF 00000000
5 01DF027F 00000FFF 00000000
// palette change shows on the next frame
1 00000044 00000123 00000000
5 00060022 00000123 00000000
1 00000044 0000000A 00000000
// ENABLE = 0: black
1 00000000 00000000 00000000
5 01DE027E 00000000 00000000
1 00000000 00000001 00000000
5 01DE027E 00000FFF 00000000
// SCROLL = 3: framebuffer row 3 at the top
1 00000008 00000003 00000000
5 00000022 0000000A 00000000
5 00010022 0000000A 00000000
5 00060022 00000000 00000000
// SCROLL = 239: the screen's row 1 shows framebuffer row 0 (wrap)
2 30000000 000000F0 00000002
1 00000008 000000EF 00000000
5 00000002 00000000 00000000
5 00020000 00000000 00000000
5 00020002 00000FFF 00000000
5 00030003 00000FFF 00000000
1 00000008 00000000 00000000
5 00000002 00000FFF 00000000
// sync timing: 800 pixels of 2 clocks per line, 525 lines per frame
6 00000000 00000640 000000C0
6 00000001 000CD140 00000C80
// STATUS and FRAME
5 00640000 00000000 00000000
11 00000000 00000000 00000000
10 000001DF 00000000 00000000
10 000001E0 00000001 00000001
10 0000020C 00000001 00000001
10 00000000 00000000 00000001
10 000001E0 00000001 00000002
